result.planSummary: Fixed the two verifier-blocking Story 2 issues by wiring live PI extension events into the capture service, adding the project-local extension entrypoint, routing relevant session and turn lifecycle events into runtime-note capture, and expanding tests so production handler registration proves live `message_end`, duplicate suppression, and runtime-note behavior while preserving existing AC-2.2 and AC-2.4 coverage.

changedFiles.reason: Registers real PI handlers for `session_start`, `session_before_switch`, `session_shutdown`, `turn_start`, `turn_end`, and `message_end`; initializes the managed thread and routes live finalized messages/runtime notes into capture-service.
Adds the project-local PI extension entrypoint that delegates to the production context steward extension implementation.
Adds production-handler tests for live prompt/response/tool-result capture, duplicate suppression, and session/turn runtime-note capture through registered PI handlers.
Adds reusable PI extension context fixture support for production extension tests.
Provides Story 2 canonical capture orchestration used by the newly wired production extension path.
Provides finalized PI message and runtime-note mapping used by the production extension path.

findingsFixed: story2-missing-live-extension-hook: added `registerContextStewardExtension` and `.pi/extensions/context-steward.ts` so live PI `message_end` events reach capture-service through real extension registration.

story2-runtime-note-events-dropped: routed `session_start`, `session_before_switch`, `session_shutdown`, `turn_start`, and `turn_end` into canonical runtime-note activity via the existing mapper/service path.
Expanded coverage so production registered handlers prove live prompt, response, tool-result, duplicate, and runtime-note behavior, while tool execution lifecycle noise remains ignored.
findingsSurfaced: `npm run verify-all` passes; its integration phase reports no integration tests found, matching the current repository state.
Live dogfooding should still confirm whether PI exposes a stronger stable live `message_end` identifier than the current response/tool/fingerprint fallback.

openQuestions: Which stable identifier is available in live PI `message_end` events during dogfooding: session entry id, response id, or only message payload fields?
result.recommendedNextStep: Proceed to verifier rerun for Story 2; next implementation story can wire the real Story 3 turn service into the capture-service turn-writer path.
